subject: Whistic profile field deprecation & migration — Nimbus Tech
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@nimbustech.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Whistic profile field deprecation & migration — Nimbus Tech

Sarah —

Quick one: Whistic shows a handful of deprecated profile fields on Nimbus' public profile that are blocking our automated CAIQ sync. Legal & Security have asked we either map or remove the fields before our SOC2 evidence push next week.

Could you confirm whether Nimbus plans to keep the deprecated fields (owner_email_old, legacy_api_endpoint) for historical reasons or whether we should map them to the new canonical fields on import? If you prefer, Camila can share a proposed field mapping and a short migration window (1–2 business days) that minimizes profile downtime.

High level ask: sign off on one of the two options below so we can proceed with the Whistic import pipeline:
- Option A: Nimbus removes deprecated keys and we ingest the cleaned profile (fastest).
- Option B: Redwood applies a one-time mapping/migration during import and marks deprecated fields as archived.

We'd like a decision by EOD Wed so the CAIQ/ SIG export hits your account before Friday's evidence snapshot.

Thanks,

Markus Klein
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: context—see linked ticket in HubSpot)
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@nimbustech.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Whistic profile field deprecation & migration — Nimbus Tech

Hi Markus —

Thanks for the heads up. We did a cleanup in March but left a few legacy keys for internal tools. Preference is Option B (mapping) to avoid disrupting internal dashboards. Two quick Qs:
1) Will mapped values retain timestamps/ownership metadata? Our compliance team requires provenance.
2) Can the migration be reversible in case we need to restore a legacy view for audits?

I'm on vacation Tue–Thu but can loop in Nimbus Security (security@nimbustech.com) to approve the mapping. If Camila can send the proposed CSV mapping and a short runbook, we'll route to our engineering lead and get back within 24 hours.

—Sarah
Security & Privacy Lead
Nimbus Tech
(Attachment: none)
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@nimbustech.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Whistic profile field deprecation & migration — Nimbus Tech

Sarah —

Thanks — attaching the proposed mapping and a short migration plan. Summary below:

What we propose (mapping + reversible archive):
- Map owner_email_old -> owner.email; preserve original timestamp in owner.metadata.original_ts
- Map legacy_api_endpoint -> api.endpoints.legacy and add api.endpoints.legacy.archived = true
- Generate a reversible archive bundle (ZIP) stored in a customer-scoped S3 path and include an integrity hash for audit.

Migration window: 2028-06-21 02:00–04:00 UTC (1–2 hours runtime). We will perform a dry-run against a staging snapshot and share the diff prior to execution.

Attachments: whistic-field-mapping-v2.csv (CSV, 18 KB) — contains field-to-field mapping and sample rows
deprecated-fields-asklist.docx (DOCX, 6 KB) — internal checklist for Nimbus approvals

If that looks good, can you ask Nimbus Security to reply-all with a short approval note? We will only run the live migration after written sign-off.

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: whistic-field-mapping-v2.csv, deprecated-fields-asklist.docx)
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@nimbustech.com>, Nimbus Tech Security <security@nimbustech.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Whistic profile field deprecation & migration — Nimbus Tech

Thanks everyone — quick update and next steps: 

- Received verbal go-ahead from Nimbus Security via Slack earlier; awaiting explicit email approval from security@nimbustech.com (Sarah's team) — Sarah, would appreciate a one-line approval when convenient.
- Camila: please schedule the dry-run for Wed 21 01:00 UTC and post the diff to the HubSpot thread referenced below.
- Markus: I'll update the HubSpot deal timeline and tag this as "Whistic field migration — approved pending email". HubSpot link: hubspot-activity-12345.link

We will include the archive bundle and integrity hash in the CAIQ export so auditors can validate the provenance during the SOC2 evidence window.

Priyom Das
Manager, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
(Attachments: hubspot-activity-12345.link)
